topic: Brokered CDs often pay more than bank CDs but trade like bonds -- sell early and you can take a loss
title: Why You Can Lose Money on a 'Safe' CD
description:
Everyone thinks CDs are perfectly safe, but that's not always true. Brokered CDs trade on a secondary market, and if you need to sell early when interest rates have gone up, you can lose part of your principal.
